description: This Java class 'ConfigurationImage' manages binary configuration data, providing methods for initialization, cloning, extracting parts of the content, and header-based extraction. It is used for handling configuration images within the software, particularly in saving and reading configuration data.

classes.name: ConfigurationImage
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a binary configuration data blob with methods for cloning, content extraction, and range retrieval.

methods.name: ConfigurationImage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the content array with a given size or a provided byte array.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size (length) of the content array.

methods.name: extractContent
methods.description: Static method that extracts the configuration content from a larger byte array, skipping the header if present.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the internal content byte array.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of the ConfigurationImage object with cloned content data.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Extracts a specified range of bytes from the content array.
